title: Boundary wall cumulative length, R50 and above, frontage greater than 8.5 m (65%)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, R50 and above where frontage is greater than 8.5m: 14m length, at which point the wall is to be set back a minimum of 3m measured from the lot boundary for a minimum length of 3m, with a cumulative maximum of 65% of the lot boundary the wall abuts.

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: cumulative maximum where frontage exceeds 8.5 m; two-thirds -> 65% (C4P1-095)

verified.note: Values clear on the page, but the page says 'cumulative maximum of 65%' while the encoded fact (building.boundary_walls.max_pct_of_boundary) is the longest single wall as % of its boundary; needs a cumulative per-boundary fact.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#length-r50-wide. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. Frontage greater than 8.5 m: cumulative maximum 65% of the boundary the wall abuts, taken as building.boundary_walls.max_pct_of_boundary.
